question: What is the meaning of refurbished parts in relation to product information?
description: Refurbished parts refer to components of a product that have been restored to a like-new condition or functionality. These parts are typically repaired or replaced to ensure the product can be used again effectively. The availability of refurbished parts is important in product information as it indicates the ability of the product to be repaired and reused, contributing to sustainability and resource efficiency.
